parts.text: A carboxylic acid reacts with an alcohol to produce an ester and water. Under certain conditions, this reaction can be reversed so an ester reacts with water to produce a carboxylic acid X and an alcohol Y . The reaction reaches an equilibrium. CH 3 CH 2 COOCH 3 + H 2 O X + Y The forward reaction is endothermic.
